editorial:
Ever wonder what actually goes on inside the head of the man trying to put us on Mars? You get a front-row seat to the chaos in this documentary. It doesn't just show the shiny rockets and fancy electric cars; it digs into the real person behind the brand. The vibe is like a high-stakes detective story where the director tries to figure out if the man is a genius saving the planet or just a billionaire with too much power. You will see old footage and new interviews that make you feel like you are right there in the boardroom during the most stressful moments of his career.

What really works here is how the movie keeps things moving fast so you never get bored. The best part is seeing the contrast between his public image and his private struggles. While some parts feel a bit biased, it is still a wild ride that gives you a lot to think about.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up by showing a quiet moment of reflection where the man looks at his empire. The final twist reveals that despite all the money and fame, he feels more alone than ever. It ends with a montage of his biggest wins and fails, leaving you to decide if his goals are worth the cost. The final shot is a slow zoom out of a rocket launch, symbolizing his endless drive to leave Earth behind.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves business stories, space, or tech news.
